source_references.usage: read-only protocol, parsing, authentication and test-semantics reference; no Python/MCP/DPAPI runtime embedded

verification.reference_source_facts: Timetable protocol and CAS service shape reviewed in the pinned UPC-MCP source and synthetic fixtures.
verification.actual_validation: 2026-11-03: Android 36 emulator completed a real self-account CAS login and a single read-only timetable index/week request, then displayed the week grid/today section and reopened from offline cache. No course text, credentials or session values are recorded here. Separately, public library/space entry pages, frontend bundles and public configuration/notices were reviewed for the six-entry study; the existing Edge had no CDP endpoint, so no authenticated business read, live network capture or write request was made in that study.
verification.formal_authorization: Not an official client and no official authorization is claimed. The user reports contact with the school; only the user's own account was used for read-only validation.

entries.name: 图书馆座位
entries.authentication: UPC CAS normal form then libspace one-time service callback; app token exchanged for libseat token
entries.verification: Existing app flow and UPC-MCP prior read-only checks cover this business; a user-authorized 26-entry HAR on 2026-11-03 confirmed live filters/floors/stats2/settings/announce and an empty current reservation for libseat. Current M4 unified-account integration remains unimplemented; layout/seat times/history/writes were not captured.
